excerpt.zh: 一只贪婪的万华镜正试图强行连接到我们在[target.GetName]上的能量中枢。这提供了一个研究这只生物独特能力的绝佳机会，但我们预计这座建筑将因此受到严重破坏。
excerpt.en: A ravenous Kaleidoscope is trying to forcibly connect itself to one our Energy Nexus on [target.GetName]. This presents a remarkable opportunity to study the being's unique abilities, but we expect the building will be severely damaged as a result.

label.zh: 就让它吃点我们的能量吧。为了科学！
label.en: Let it eat our energy. For Science!
